Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model

Record Class AnalystNote

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.AnalystNote
Record Components:
noteId - unique identifier (UUID)
userEmail - owner's email address (FK to app_users)
targetType - classification of the annotated entity
targetId - the slug, articleId, eventId, or trialId of the target
targetLabel - human-readable label for display (e.g. company name, article title)
content - the note text (free-form, up to 5000 chars)
createdAt - when the note was created
updatedAt - when the note was last edited (null if never edited)
public record AnalystNote(String noteId, String userEmail, NoteTargetType targetType, String targetId, String targetLabel, String content, Instant createdAt, Instant updatedAt) extends Record
Immutable domain record representing a private analyst note attached to an entity (company, article, regulatory event, clinical trial, or wiki page).

Each note belongs to a single user and is identified by a UUID. The targetType and targetId together identify the annotated entity. The targetLabel is denormalized for display so the central notes page does not need to resolve entity names.
